verdict.rationale: Viam offers data capture, storage, SQL/MQL querying, and ML model training/inference pipelines, but the evidence pack contains no mention of an AI feature that proactively generates insights or suggestions from collected data (e.g., automated anomaly detection, natural-language summaries, or recommendation surfaces). Agent-related docs (viam-docs-12, 31, 32) describe agents *operating* machines via APIs, not the product surfacing AI-generated insights to users.
